facts.activity_file: gas testing before and during hot work

control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - change request not applied to K-7301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on K-7301 and ZV-7212 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically gas testing before and during hot work. K-7301 (vapour recovery compressor) is in service for loading vapour recovery. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 29 February 2012 a planned field verification of K-7301 and ZV-7212 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch not effective.
